description: The legal status of one peptide, GLP-1 drug or seller-named blend (KLOW, GLOW, the Wolverine stack) in the United States (FDA), Australia (TGA), the UK (MHRA), the EU (EMA), Canada (Health Canada), Brazil (ANVISA, where covered) and sport (WADA), or in the one place you name. Returns each status with a plain-language note; for the U.S. also the full answer (compounding rules, the latest FDA advisory vote, the next dated event), plus primary sources and the date it was last verified.

compound.description: A compound by name, brand, code or street name ("BPC-157", "Ozempic", "reta", "TB500"), or a blend ("KLOW", "GLOW", "Wolverine stack").

place.description: A country, region or regulator: "Australia", "UK", "Germany" (EU), "Brazil", "FDA", or "sport" for WADA. Omit it for every place.

name: check_legal_status
title: Is this peptide legal?
